outcome: Lumbar spine range of motion (bilateral side bending)
Lumbar spine range of motion (axial rotation)
cohort: The study included 66 women divided into three groups: 25 women who had Cesarean births, 16 women who had vaginal births, and 25 women who had never been pregnant (controls).
finding: Cesarean birth women exhibited persistent limitations in lumbar extension and side bending range of motion beyond the puerperium compared to controls and vaginal birth women.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth women demonstrated significantly decreased lumbar extension and bilateral side bending ROMs compared to both vaginal birth women and controls, suggesting vaginal birth may be more favorable for postpartum spinal recovery.
